text: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS compound_pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase AS compound_max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type AS compound_molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS compound_canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary JOIN compound_records ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno JOIN docs ON compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142268' ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC
